svg.title: Four capacity numbers - bandwidth sized to N minus one, port and session arithmetic, table sizes and a measured convergence budget
svg.desc: Bandwidth: peak is seventy percent outbound and thirty percent inbound in the example, and N minus one means the remaining exit after a failure must still carry the peak, so with a seventy-thirty split each exit must be sized to one hundred percent of peak rather than buying two five-hundred-megabit links and calling it a gigabit; the acceptance test is to disconnect one link and load to peak without loss, and the common mistake is planning fifty-fifty when the real ratio is ninety-ten. Port and session math: public addresses multiplied by forty-five thousand usable ports gives the concurrency ceiling, new connections per second decide whether nine o'clock collapses, and session table size divided by ageing time gives steady-state concurrency, so three numbers must be measured rather than guessed. Table sizes cover a full internet table of roughly 950 thousand to one million routes in 2026, the reduced FIB pressure of default-only exits, neighbours multiplied by received prefixes, and mandatory maximum-prefix limits. The convergence budget adds link detection, BFD at about 900 milliseconds, the default BGP hold timer of 180 seconds that nobody can wait for, session rebuild and a 300 second DNS TTL into the recovery time a user actually feels.
svg.text: Four capacity numbers and one time budget that decide the edge
Bandwidth, ports, table size and session rate are bought separately; convergence is the number nobody puts in the contract.
BANDWIDTH: SIZE TO N-1, NOT TO THE SUM
峰值 = 出向 70% + 入向 30%（举例）
N-1 要求：单出口失效后剩余仍 >= 峰值
70/30 双出口 → 每口至少 100% 峰值
不要按“两条 500M = 1G”买
运营商侧对等与清洗带宽是另一份合同
验收：断开一条，压测到峰值不掉
常见错：按 50/50 规划，实际 90/10
先测比例，再定容量
PORT AND SESSION MATH
公网 IP x 45k 可用端口 = 并发上限
CPS（每秒新建）决定 09:00 是否雪崩
会话表上限 + 老化时间 = 稳态并发
三个必须测的数
- 每终端并发会话（实测，不猜）
- 峰值 CPS（登录风暴 / 应用刷新）
- 老化时间与真实流量是否匹配
会话表先满，带宽往往还有余量
TABLES AND TIMERS: THE NUMBERS NOBODY PUTS IN THE CONTRACT
Table sizes
- 完整互联网路由 ≈ 95 万 - 100 万条（2026）
- 只要默认路由的出口：FIB 压力骤降，但失去前缀级选路
- BGP 邻居 × 接收前缀数 = 内存与收敛时间
- 最大前缀限制（max-prefix）必须配，防泄漏
- 平台 FIB 容量与“支持 BGP”是两件事
Convergence budget, measured
- 链路 down → 接口感知：毫秒
- BGP 默认 hold 180 s（等不起）
- 会话重建 + DNS TTL 300 s = 用户侧长尾
- 把四个数相加，才是用户感受到的恢复时间
Write the four numbers on one page, with the test that produced each
Peak bandwidth per exit, usable public ports, session table and CPS, and total recovery time from failure to a working user session.
Every one of them is measurable before production, and every one of them has been the actual cause of an edge outage somewhere.
